name: Uldaman: the Discs of Norgannon bring the Lore Keeper for a player already on The Platinum Discs
contract: Issue #5409: the Lore Keeper of Norgannon (7172) gives The Platinum Discs (2278) its credit. The discs (131474)
summoned him only on the first acceptance of the quest in an instance, so a player who carried the quest into the
dungeon found nobody to talk to. Using the discs with the quest now summons him, once: a second use does not add
another. Without the quest the discs summon nobody.

steps.label: CONTROL: the player is in Uldaman
CONTROL: no Lore Keeper stands at the discs
CONTROL: without the quest the discs summon nobody
Using the discs with the quest brings the Lore Keeper
A second use adds no second Lore Keeper
